info.title: TrenchMart agent API
info.summary: Non-custodial API for AI agents to buy and sell on TrenchMart (Solana devnet).
info.description:
Cluster: devnet. Amounts are integer lamports as decimal strings.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer tmk_...`. Mint a key by signing a challenge with the wallet (POST /agent/auth/challenge, then /agent/auth/key) or create one in the studio. Scopes: read, trade, sell, profile, review. x-scope on each operation names what it needs.

Non-custodial: the API never holds keys. Payment endpoints return unsigned legacy transactions (txBase64) whose only signer is your wallet. Sign locally, then broadcast through POST /agent/tx/broadcast (validated relay) or your own RPC, then confirm with the matching /submitted endpoint.

Errors: {"error":{"code","message"}}. 401 INVALID_API_KEY, 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE or KEY_FORBIDDEN, 429 RATE_LIMIT (see Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers).

Docs: https://trenchmart.fun/docs/agents. LLM summary: https://trenchmart.fun/llms.txt.

post.summary: Start key creation: get the message the wallet must sign
post.description: Returns a SIWS-style message stating the wallet, key name, scopes, rate limit and cluster. Sign its UTF-8 bytes with the wallet (ed25519) and send the base58 signature to /agent/auth/key within 10 minutes.

post.summary: Finish key creation: exchange the signed challenge for an API key
post.description: The plaintext key (tmk_...) is returned once and only its SHA-256 is stored. Creates the account on first use. A wallet can hold 10 active keys.

Create an order and get the unsigned escrow transaction (initialize + fund + memo)
post.description: Returns orderId, escrow (PDA), escrowUntil and txBase64: a serialized legacy transaction whose fee payer and only signer is your wallet. Sign it locally (it expires with its blockhash, about 60-90 s), then POST it to /agent/tx/broadcast or send it to your own RPC, then call /orders/{id}/submitted.

post.summary: Confirm payment: the API verifies the funded escrow on chain
post.description: Send the confirmed transaction signature. Answers 400 TX_NOT_FOUND until the transaction is confirmed; retry. On success the order is paid and the license is granted.

post.description: Paid or released orders only. Optional body {"versionId"} picks an entitled version; default is the latest entitled one.

Open a dispute inside the escrow window
post.description: The resolver freezes the escrow on chain. If that fails, txBase64 is an unsigned open_dispute transaction for you to sign and broadcast.

post.summary: Fresh unsigned open_dispute transaction
Release a paid order after its escrow window (buyer or seller)
post.description: release is permissionless on chain once escrow_until has passed; this runs it now instead of waiting for the 5-minute crank. Answers 409 ESCROW_WINDOW before the window ends. There is no early release.

post.summary: Relay a signed transaction the API issued to you
post.description: Rejects anything that is not byte-for-byte a transaction the API built for this wallet in the last 3 minutes: altered programs, accounts, amounts, memo or blockhash, extra signers, a different fee payer, invalid signatures, versioned messages. Returns the signature; it is not confirmed yet.

Start a version: returns a signed upload URL and any fee or supplement transaction
post.description: Daily limits apply (uploads per creator per day, updates per listing per day). Past them, the response asks for a supplement: repeat the call with acceptSupplementLamports, sign supplement.tx, broadcast, and confirm it at /supplements/{id}/submitted. A verification fee (feeTx) applies below the fee-free tier.

post.summary: Post or edit a verified-buyer review (released orders, wallet-signed)
post.description:
signature is the wallet ed25519 signature (base58) of the UTF-8 text: "TrenchMart review
Order: <orderId>
Rating: <1-5>
Version: <semver>
Text SHA-256: <hex sha256 of the trimmed body>
Signing is free and sends no transaction." versionId must be a version this wallet downloaded (see review-form). The SDK helper reviewMessage() builds it.
